bucket-reuse-aggregation.purpose:
Real scheduler jobs and full TTS A/B against a saved nested decoder.

Uses a controlled ready queue, normal EOS and first/non-first production
profiles. No playback, ASR, real conversation text or model downloads. The
current inferencer owns the shared non-AR stack; only the decoder is swapped.

source_note: Performance/aggregation measurements precede a metrics-only fix: final_kv now derives from initial_kv + decode step count rather than inspecting KV[0]. Attention, sampling, routing and promotion are unchanged; final regression runs validate the final source.

full_model_less.failure: One texture-cache null-origin HTTP request got Windows ConnectionAbortedError 10053; isolated full suite rerun 25 passed. No texture code changes.

limitations: Existing logs contain task character/fragment counts and startup buckets, not measured KV or overflow; token-rate estimates are not promoted to measurements.
Controlled aggregation uses a ready synthetic queue with deadlines disabled, no physical playback, no live LLM, no ASR overlap; all non-first production synthesis profiles are preserved.
Long FA2 runs can differ from the old full-context dynamic SDPA path: 6/10 synthetic 600-step pairs and 2/5 real 83-character pairs differ. No quality-equivalence claim or listening evaluation.
Full-bucket FA2 controls match promotion exactly: 600 teacher-forced logits have maximum error zero; 20 fixed-work token pairs and 20 full-TTS token/PCM pairs match.
Paired timings are finite samples without frequency locking; some runs overlap CPU regression work. Startup timings are one preparation per construction order, not long-run first-voice guarantees.
Graph coverage excludes prefill, disabled/deferred capture, batch>1, initially unroutable KV and requests exceeding the largest prepared target.
No upstream issue posted; PR remains draft; associated Amadeus issue for the public setting/default is still pending.
hash_encoding_note: source_sha256 fields hash the actual local UTF-8 runtime files (Windows CRLF). final_git_blob_sha256 hashes staged LF Git blobs for checkout-independent verification.
